meanings.meaning: 帆船运动（指利用风力推动船只行驶的活动或方式） adj. 帆船的

meanings.usage: 正式用语，指大型船只或容器
描述给人留下深刻印象的事物
使某人想起某事的事物
指代代相传的风俗或习惯
指历史上具有特征的时期
表示在质量或能力上相当
指控制船只或车辆的方向
船上用于控制方向的装置
强调规模或程度非常大
指事情被推迟或延误的状态
指值得注意的、不寻常的
地球南北之间的假想线

phrases.usage: 出发；启程，指开始一段旅程

examples.en: Both ships set out from Shanghai on June 18th, 1872.
examples.zh: 两艘船于1872年6月18日从上海出发。

examples.en: On the Indian Ocean, the Cutty Sark took the lead.
examples.zh: 在印度洋上，卡蒂萨克号取得了领先。

phrases.usage: 被击中；遭受，指突然遭遇不好的事情

examples.en: In August, she was struck by a very heavy storm.
examples.zh: 八月，她遭遇了一场猛烈的暴风雨。

examples.en: Because of this, the Cutty Sark lost her lead.
examples.zh: 因此，卡蒂萨克号失去了领先地位。

phrases.usage: （船等）停靠，指在某个港口停留

examples.en: The captain called in at a port to have a new rudder fitted.
examples.zh: 船长将船停靠在一个港口，让工人安装新舵。

phrases.usage: 左右摇晃，形容船只不稳地晃动

examples.en: The Cutty Sark rolled from side to side and it became impossible to steer her.
examples.zh: 卡蒂萨克号左右摇晃，变得无法操控。

phrases.usage: 困难地安装，形容做某事很艰难

examples.en: A temporary rudder was made and it was fitted with great difficulty.
examples.zh: 一个临时舵被制造出来，但安装得非常困难。

phrases.usage: 毫无疑问...，用于强调确信某事

examples.en: There is no doubt that if she had not lost her rudder she would have won the race easily.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，如果她没有失去舵，她会轻松赢得比赛。

examples.en: Before they were replaced by steamships, sailing vessels were used to carry tea.
examples.zh: 在被汽船取代之前，帆船被用来运茶。

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某个时间点之前已经完成的动作或状态，常与一般过去时连用 用于描述发生在过去之前的事件，常用于复合句中

examples.en: The first of the two ships to reach Java after the race had begun was the Thermopylae.
examples.zh: 比赛开始后，第一艘到达爪哇的船是Thermopylae号。

examples.en: She had had many delays before arriving in England.
examples.zh: 她在到达英国之前经历了许多延误。

grammar.title: 虚拟语气 (Subjunctive Mood) - 与过去事实相反
grammar.structure: if + 主语 + had + 过去分词, 主语 + would/could/might have + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 用来表达与事实相反的假设或不可能发生的情况 用于谈论与过去事实相反的假设

examples.en: If she had not lost her rudder, she would have won the race easily.
examples.zh: 如果她没有失去舵，她本会轻松赢得比赛。

examples.en: If it had not rained, we would have gone out.
examples.zh: 如果没有下雨，我们本会出去。

grammar.title: 过去分词作定语 (Past Participle as Adjective)
grammar.structure: 过去分词 + 名词 或 名词 + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 过去分词可用作形容词，修饰名词，表示被动或完成的意义 用于简化定语从句，使句子更简洁

examples.en: The only other ship to match her was the Thermopylae.
examples.zh: 唯一能与她匹敌的另一艘船是Thermopylae号。

examples.en: She serves as an impressive reminder of the great ships of the past.
examples.zh: 她作为一个令人印象深刻的纪念物，提醒人们过去伟大的船只。

original.en: It seemed certain that she would be the first ship home.
original.zh: 她似乎是第一个到达的船，这似乎是确定的。

imitations.en: It seemed certain that he would pass the exam.
imitations.zh: 他似乎一定会通过考试。

imitations.en: It seemed certain that our team would win the match.
imitations.zh: 我们队似乎一定会赢得比赛。

original.en: There is no doubt that if she had not lost her rudder she would have won the race easily.
original.zh: 毫无疑问，如果她没有失去舵，她会轻松赢得比赛。

imitations.en: There is no doubt that hard work leads to success.
imitations.zh: 毫无疑问，努力工作会带来成功。

imitations.en: There is no doubt that she is the best student in the class.
imitations.zh: 毫无疑问，她是班上最好的学生。

patterns.pattern: The only other...to do something was...

original.en: The only other ship to match her was the Thermopylae.
original.zh: 唯一能与她匹敌的另一艘船是Thermopylae号。

imitations.en: The only other student to finish the test early was Tom.
imitations.zh: 唯一另一个提前完成考试的学生是汤姆。

imitations.en: The only other country to win the championship three times was Brazil.
imitations.zh: 唯一另一个三次赢得冠军的国家是巴西。

original.en: Because of this, the Cutty Sark lost her lead.
original.zh: 因此，卡蒂萨克号失去了领先地位。

imitations.en: Because of this, he decided to change his major.
Because of the heavy traffic, we arrived late.
imitations.zh: 因为交通拥堵，我们迟到了。

lines.en: One of the most famous sailing ships of the nineteenth century, the Cutty Sark, can still be seen at Greewich.
lines.zh: 人们在格林威治仍可看到19世纪最有名的帆船之一“卡蒂萨克”号。

lines.en: She stands on dry land and is visited by thousands of people each year.
lines.zh: 它停在陆地上，每年接待成千上万的参观者。

lines.en: She serves as an impressive reminder of the great ships of past.
lines.zh: 它给人们留下深刻的印象，使人们回忆起历史上的巨型帆船，在蒸汽船取代帆船之前。

lines.en: Before they were replaced by steamships , sailing vessels like the Cutty Sark were used to carry tea from China and wool from Australia.
lines.zh: “卡蒂萨克”号之类的帆船被用来从中国运回茶叶，从澳大利亚运回羊毛。

lines.en: The Cutty Sark was one the fastest sailing ships that has ever been built.
lines.zh: “卡蒂萨克”号是帆船制造史上建造的最快的一艘帆船。

lines.en: The only other ship to match her was the Thermopylae.
lines.zh: 唯一可以与之一比高低的是“塞姆皮雷”号帆船。

lines.en: Both these ships set out from Shanghai on June 18th, 1872 on an exciting race to England.
lines.zh: 两船于1872年6月18日同时从上海启航驶往英国，途中展开了一场激烈的比赛。

lines.en: This race, which went on for exactly four exactly four months, was the last of its kind.
lines.zh: 这场比赛持续了整整4个月，是这类比赛中的最后一次，它标志着帆船伟大传统的结束与一个新纪元的开始。

lines.en: It marked the end of the great tradition of ships with sails and the beginning of a new era.
lines.zh: 比赛开始后，“赛姆皮雷”号率先抵达爪哇岛。

lines.en: The first of the two ships to reach Java after the race had begun was the Thermopylae, but on the Indian Ocean, the Cutty Sark took lead.
lines.zh: 但在印度洋上，“卡萨萨克”号驶到了前面。

lines.en: It seemed certain that she would be the first ship home, but during the race she had a lot of bad luck.
lines.zh: 看来，它首先返抵英国是确信无疑的了，但它却在比赛中连遭厄运。

lines.en: In August, she was struck by a very heavy storm during which her rudder was torn away.
lines.zh: 8月份“卡蒂萨克”号遭到一场特大风暴的袭击，失去了一只舵。

lines.en: The Cutty Sark rolled from side to side and it became impossible to steer her.
lines.zh: 船身左右摇晃，无法操纵。

lines.en: A temporary rudder was made on board from spare planks and it was fitted with great difficulty.
lines.zh: 船员用备用的木板在船上赶制了一只应急用的舵，并克服重重困难将舵安装就位，这样一来，大大降低了船的航速。

lines.en: This greatly reduced the speed of the ship, for there was a danger that if she traveled too quickly, this rudder would be torn away as well.
lines.zh: 因为船不能开得太快，否则就有危险，应急舵也会被刮走。

lines.en: Because of this, the Cutty Sark lost her lead.
lines.zh: 因为这个缘故，“卡蒂萨克”号落到了后面。

lines.en: After crossing the Equator, the captain called in at a port to have a new rudder fitted, but by now the Thermopylae was over five hundred miles ahead.
lines.zh: 跨越赤道后，船长将船停靠在一个港口，在那儿换了一只舵。

lines.en: Though the new rudder was fitted at tremendous speed, it was impossible for the Cutty Sark to win.
lines.zh: 但此时，“赛姆皮雷”号早已在500多英里之遥了。

lines.en: She arrived in England a week after the Thermopylae.
lines.zh: 尽管换装新舵时分秒必争，但“卡蒂萨克”号已经不可能取胜了，它抵达英国时比“塞姆皮雷”号晚了1个星期。

lines.en: Even this was remarkable , considering that she had had so many delays.
lines.zh: 但考虑到路上的多次耽搁，这个成绩也已很不容易了。

lines.en: These is no doubt that if she had not lost her rudder she would have won the race easily.
lines.zh: 毫无疑问，如果中途没有失去舵，“卡帝萨克”号肯定能在比赛中轻易夺冠。

questions.q: What piece of bad luck prevented the Cutty Sark from winning the race?
questions.zh: 是什么坏运气使“卡蒂萨克”号未能赢得这场比赛？
questions.a: In August, during the race, she was struck by a very heavy storm, and her rudder was torn away.
questions.aZh: 8 月比赛途中，它遭到一场特大风暴的袭击，船舵被刮走了。
questions.hint: 答案出自课文：In August, she was struck by a very heavy storm during which her rudder was torn away.

questions.q: What were sailing vessels like the Cutty Sark used to carry, and from where?
questions.zh: 像“卡蒂萨克”号这样的帆船被用来运送什么？从哪里运？
questions.a: They were used to carry tea from China and wool from Australia.
questions.aZh: 它们被用来从中国运茶叶，从澳大利亚运羊毛。
questions.hint: 见课文：sailing vessels like the Cutty Sark were used to carry tea from China and wool from Australia.

questions.q: When and from where did the two ships set out for England?
questions.zh: 这两艘船何时、从何处启航驶往英国？
questions.a: Both ships set out from Shanghai on June 18th, 1872.
questions.aZh: 两船于 1872 年 6 月 18 日从上海启航。
questions.hint: 见课文：Both these ships set out from Shanghai on June 18th, 1872 on an exciting race to England.

questions.q: How did the crew deal with the lost rudder, and why did this reduce the ship's speed?
questions.zh: 船员如何应对失去的船舵？为什么这会降低船速？
questions.a: A temporary rudder was made on board from spare planks and fitted with great difficulty; the speed was reduced because the ship could not travel too quickly, or the rudder would be torn away as well.
questions.aZh: 船员用备用木板在船上赶制了一只应急舵，并费尽力气把它装上；船不能开得太快，否则应急舵也会被刮走，所以航速大为降低。
questions.hint: 见课文：A temporary rudder was made on board from spare planks...This greatly reduced the speed of the ship.

questions.q: What does the last sentence suggest about the result of the race, and what grammatical structure does it use?
questions.zh: 课文最后一句对比赛结果作了怎样的暗示？它用了什么语法结构？
questions.a: It suggests that if she had not lost her rudder, the Cutty Sark would have won the race easily. It uses the subjunctive mood — a counterfactual condition about the past (if + had done, would have done).
questions.aZh: 它暗示：如果中途没有失去船舵，“卡蒂萨克”号本可轻松夺冠。句子用了虚拟语气，是对过去情况的假设（if + had done, would have done）。
questions.hint: 见课文最后一句：There is no doubt that if she had not lost her rudder she would have won the race easily.

translation:
人们在格林威治仍可看到19世纪最有名的帆船之一“卡蒂萨克”号。
它停在陆地上，每年接待成千上万的参观者。
它给人们留下深刻的印象，使人们回忆起历史上的巨型帆船，在蒸汽船取代帆船之前。
“卡蒂萨克”号之类的帆船被用来从中国运回茶叶，从澳大利亚运回羊毛。
“卡蒂萨克”号是帆船制造史上建造的最快的一艘帆船。
唯一可以与之一比高低的是“塞姆皮雷”号帆船。
两船于1872年6月18日同时从上海启航驶往英国，途中展开了一场激烈的比赛。
这场比赛持续了整整4个月，是这类比赛中的最后一次，它标志着帆船伟大传统的结束与一个新纪元的开始。
比赛开始后，“赛姆皮雷”号率先抵达爪哇岛。
但在印度洋上，“卡萨萨克”号驶到了前面。
看来，它首先返抵英国是确信无疑的了，但它却在比赛中连遭厄运。
8月份“卡蒂萨克”号遭到一场特大风暴的袭击，失去了一只舵。
船身左右摇晃，无法操纵。
船员用备用的木板在船上赶制了一只应急用的舵，并克服重重困难将舵安装就位，这样一来，大大降低了船的航速。
因为船不能开得太快，否则就有危险，应急舵也会被刮走。
因为这个缘故，“卡蒂萨克”号落到了后面。
跨越赤道后，船长将船停靠在一个港口，在那儿换了一只舵。
但此时，“赛姆皮雷”号早已在500多英里之遥了。
尽管换装新舵时分秒必争，但“卡蒂萨克”号已经不可能取胜了，它抵达英国时比“塞姆皮雷”号晚了1个星期。
但考虑到路上的多次耽搁，这个成绩也已很不容易了。
毫无疑问，如果中途没有失去舵，“卡帝萨克”号肯定能在比赛中轻易夺冠。
title: The Cutty Sark
subtitle: 卡蒂萨克号

lead.question: 19 世纪最快的帆船“卡蒂萨克”号，为何在 1872 年那场著名远洋比赛中落败？
lead.warmup: 1872 年 6 月 18 日，两艘当时最快的帆船——“卡蒂萨克”号与“塞姆皮雷”号——同时从上海启航，展开一场驶往英国的激烈比赛。这场持续整整四个月的较量，是帆船时代最后一次远洋竞赛，也标志着一个古老传统的落幕。途中“卡蒂萨克”号一度领先，却在印度洋上突遭厄运。学完本课，你就会弄清它究竟因何功亏一篑。
goals: 掌握 clipper、sail、rudder、steer 等航海词汇，读懂“卡蒂萨克”号的故事。
理解并运用比较级、最高级描述最快的帆船与两船的速度对比。
掌握被动语态（was struck / was torn away / was fitted）在叙事中的用法。
学会用 There is no doubt that 与虚拟语气表达对过去情况的假设。
lead.summary: “卡蒂萨克”号是 19 世纪最快的帆船之一，当年往返中国、澳大利亚运送茶叶和羊毛。1872 年它和“塞姆皮雷”号从上海启航，比赛驶向英国。尽管它在印度洋上一度领先，八月的一场特大风暴却刮走了船舵，船员只好在船上赶制应急舵，航速因此大减。它最终晚一个星期抵达英国。课文指出：若不是中途失去船舵，它本可轻松夺冠。
lead.tips: 注意区分 take the lead（取得领先）与 lose one's lead（失去领先）；tear away 的被动过去分词是 torn away，不可写成 teared，rudder 是可数名词，勿漏冠词。

exercises.q: 汉译英：“卡蒂萨克”号是有史以来建造的最快帆船之一。
exercises.a: The Cutty Sark was one of the fastest sailing ships that has ever been built.
exercises.note: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词

exercises.q: 汉译英：帆船被用来从中国运茶叶，从澳大利亚运羊毛。
exercises.a: Sailing vessels were used to carry tea from China and wool from Australia.
exercises.note: be used to do 表用途，用被动

exercises.q: 用 clipper / sail / rudder / steer 的适当形式填空：The Cutty Sark was a famous ______, a fast ship with ______. Without a ______, the crew could not ______ her.
exercises.note: 航海名词与 steer 用法

exercises.q: 句型转换（改为被动语态）：A very heavy storm struck the Cutty Sark in August.
exercises.a: The Cutty Sark was struck by a very heavy storm in August.
exercises.note: 主动改被动，注意过去分词

exercises.q: 用 take the lead / lose one's lead 的适当形式填空：On the Indian Ocean, the Cutty Sark ______, but a heavy storm made her ______.
exercises.a: took the lead; lose her lead
exercises.note: take / lose the lead 搭配

exercises.q: 改错：The Cutty Sark was one of the fastest sailing ship that has ever been built.
exercises.a: ship→ships; has→have（one of the fastest sailing ships that have ever been built）
exercises.note: one of 后接复数名词

exercises.q: 用括号内动词的适当形式填空：There is no doubt that if she ______ (not lose) her rudder, she ______ (win) the race easily.
exercises.a: had not lost; would have won
exercises.note: 虚拟语气对过去的假设

quiz.q: “卡蒂萨克”号如今陈列在哪里？
options: In Shanghai.
At Greenwich.
In Australia.
At Java.

quiz.q: “卡蒂萨克”号过去从哪里运茶叶，从哪里运羊毛？
options: Tea from Australia and wool from China.
Tea from Java and wool from England.
Tea from China and wool from Australia.
Tea from England and wool from Java.

quiz.q: 哪艘船是唯一能与“卡蒂萨克”号匹敌的？
options: The Thermopylae.
The Shanghai.
The Java.
The Greenwich.

quiz.q: 比赛中“卡蒂萨克”号遭遇的坏运气是什么？
options: She ran out of food at sea.
She lost her way to England.
She was left far behind at Java.
Her rudder was torn away in a storm.

quiz.q: 失去船舵后，船员是怎样应对的？
options: They turned back to Shanghai.
They gave up the race at once.
They made a temporary rudder on board.
They waited for another ship to help.

quiz.q: 课文最后一句表达了什么意思？
options: She won the race in the end.
She would have won easily if she had not lost her rudder.
The race was never finished.
The Thermopylae also lost its rudder.
